name: brewpack
description: Local-first toolkit for scaffolding and validating small Homebrew tap repositories.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: node ./bin/brewpack.js inspect ./fixtures/sample-tool --output ./tmp/smoke-inspect --format both && node ./bin/brewpack.js init ./fixtures/sample-tool --output ./tmp/smoke-tap --force && node ./bin/brewpack.js validate ./tmp/smoke-tap
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
